headline: Nigerian President Nominates Six Executive Directors for NMDPRA
summary: Nigerian President Bola Ahmed Tinubu nominated six executive directors for the Nigerian Midstream and Downstream Petroleum Regulatory Authority, seeking senate approval.
why: Appointments to key regulatory bodies shape policy execution and oversight in the vital petroleum midstream and downstream sectors.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Regulatory leadership changes influence governance and operational approvals in the domestic energy sector.
